jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Material Intelligence

jobs.title: Director, Healthcare & Life Sciences

jobs.title: Molchanov Sustainability Internship 2026-2027
jobs.reason: Chatham House is a world-leading international affairs think tank, and multiple host teams (Europe Programme/Russia and Eurasia, UK in the World/US and North America, MENA) sit squarely within the candidate's IR and security policy focus. The internship explicitly targets early-career professionals and emphasises research support, policy writing, and event work — all aligned with the candidate's research-assistant track record and writing skills.

jobs.title: Programs US (Graduate/Masters Associate Intern)
jobs.reason: OSF is a major policy/grantmaking foundation, but this specific role focuses on US domestic programs mapping and grantmaking analysis rather than the candidate's core IR/international law/security interests. Research, analysis, and writing skills transfer cleanly, and the intern-level framing matches the candidate's stage perfectly. Note: the role requires US work authorization (no sponsorship), which may be a practical barrier.

jobs.title: Geostrategy Analyst
jobs.reason: Eurasia Group is a core target firm in commercial geopolitical risk, and the substantive focus on geopolitical analysis, custom research, and client-facing memos aligns strongly with the candidate's IR/security background and writing skills. However, the role asks for 2–3 years of work experience plus client-facing experience and ideally a consulting background, which stretches beyond the candidate's current student-assistant profile.
